deviations: Signed out (is_authorized=false): AI-generated models, images, and RSG tokens unavailable until sign-in; optional TTS not planned.

Main script is the user-mandated existing Assets/Scripts/CPRCoach.ts (class CPRCoach, extended not rewritten) instead of CPRCoachMain.ts; existing @inputs (instructionText, counterText, guide, guideVisual, clickAudio, camera, bpm, pressDepth, handRadius, swapEvery) and next() kept.

instructionText/counterText stay declared but become @allowUndefined fallbacks: text now lives in the CPRCoachUI module and CPRCoach writes through its setters (writes to the Text inputs only when wired).

Hold is a sub-state of Step.Place (handsOnSince >= 0), not a new enum value; Swap is a sub-state of Step.Push. Tab index map: Check=0, Call=1, Watch/Place/Hold=2, Push/Swap=3, Done=4; step label 'Step N of 5' = tab+1.

Real-glasses pinch-to-pin on the world mesh is not built (untestable in preview, brief marks it feel-unproven); on device the guide falls back to the existing camera-relative placeGuide(). Two-palm check kept as an alternative hold trigger.

Layout positions are relative to the camera pose at Lens start (preview camera assumed at origin); CPRCoachPlacement recomputes them at onStart. Manikin long axis runs along camera forward with the head away from the user, so 'toward head' = further away (-Z).

Manikin code-authored backend: CPRCoach only needs a SceneObject handle 'Manikin' (proxy Assets/GeneratedMeshes/Manikin.glb today); whatever the mesh step produces must keep that root name, grounded min-Y=0, head toward local -Z.

theme.style: realistic, clean, medical training, frosted glass UI
theme.palette: light neutral grey, bright white, soft green confirm, emergency red #F2392C accent

assets.name: Manikin
assets.description: adult CPR training manikin lying face-up on its back, built from simple rounded primitives: sphere head, short cylinder neck, broad capsule torso with flat chest, two capsule arms resting at its sides; uniform light neutral grey matte

assets.name: BeatClick

assets.name: ButtonPress
assets.description: soft short UI confirm tap for pinching the step button

assets.name: HoldComplete
assets.description: brief gentle rising two-tone confirm chime when the 1 second hands-in-place hold completes

assets.name: warning
assets.description: alert icon for the Check step tab

assets.name: call
assets.description: phone icon for the Call 112 step tab

assets.name: back_hand
assets.description: hand icon for Watch first / Place hands / Hold step tab

assets.name: monitor_heart
assets.description: heartbeat icon for Push / Swap step tab

assets.name: check_circle
assets.description: check icon for Help is here step tab

assets.name: CPRCoachUI
assets.description: Frosted-glass light translucent grey step window with vertical step tab bar on its left edge; light text for additive display; one card visible at a time; switches between head-follow and chest-anchored placement

elements.name: stepWindow
elements.description: Frosted glass rounded window: small 60% white step label, large white semibold instruction, counter as the largest element, readable from 60-80 cm
labels: Call 112. Put the phone on speaker.
Match your hands to the guide. Arms straight. Shoulders over hands.
Swap with someone if you can

elements.name: actionButton
elements.description: Single large pinch button inside the window; red #F2392C on Check, hidden on Place hands and Hold; highlights on hover

elements.name: holdProgress
elements.description: Short horizontal progress bar filling over 1 s, visible only in Hold step, resets to empty on early release

elements.name: stepTabBar
elements.description: Vertical glass capsule on the left edge of the window with 5 round icon tabs (warning, call, back_hand, monitor_heart, check_circle); active = filled white circle with dark icon, finished = white icon, upcoming = 45% opacity; display-only

spatial_layout.name: CPRCoach
spatial_layout.note: empty manager root at top of hierarchy; carries CPRCoach.ts and the three AudioComponents

spatial_layout.name: Manikin
spatial_layout.note: grounded origin at base on floor (floor = camY - 90); head toward -Z; chest top face y=-66; chest point (lower half of breastbone, nipple line) = local (0,24,-12) = world (0,-66,-60) i.e. manikinDistance 60 ahead; enabled at start, disabled when !global.deviceInfoSystem.isEditor(); TODO: verify with aabb_cm

spatial_layout.name: HandsGuide
spatial_layout.note: plane scaled to 22x22 lying flat, normal +Y; unlit alpha-blended material, baseTex hands_white.png / hands_green.png; components: RenderMeshVisual, box ColliderComponent 22x22x4, IK Interactable; hidden until Watch; press anim moves down by pressDepth
spatial_layout.relation: on Manikin chest (22x22 footprint < 55 cm chest width), 0.5 cm above chest top face

spatial_layout.name: Heart
spatial_layout.note: unlit alpha-blended plane heart.png, upright, rotated at anchor time to face the camera; visible only in Push; pulse 1.0->1.12 per beat; x 15..25 vs guide x -11..11 = 4 cm gap
spatial_layout.relation: near HandsGuide (20 cm right, chest height)

spatial_layout.name: CPRCoachUI (follow pose: Check, Call)
spatial_layout.frame: world, scene-root parent (local == world), updated per frame
spatial_layout.note: lazy head-follow: target = camPos + flatForward*followDistance(45), y = camY - 3; lerp ~4/s, yaw-only face camera; span x -10.1..10.1 fits 21.7 cm visible width at 45 cm; y -10.5..4.5 inside visible band -19..+10.6 at 45 cm

spatial_layout.name: CPRCoachUI (chest-anchored pose: Watch..Done)
spatial_layout.note: anchored once at Watch: position = chestPos + towardHead*25 + up*12 (towardHead = manikin -Z); rotation = look at camera position at anchor time (tilted ~32 deg to face user), then fixed; scale = chestWindowScale 1.5; window z=-85 is behind guide z -71..-49, no overlap
spatial_layout.relation: near HandsGuide (25 cm beyond toward head, 12 cm up)

spatial_layout.name: StepWindow
spatial_layout.note: UIKit Frame full extent 15x12 incl. 1.5 cm margins (not the 4 cm default); contents top to bottom: stepLabel y +4.5, instruction y +2, counter (largest) y -1, holdProgress 10x0.8 y -3.5 (Hold only), actionButton 10x2.6 y -4.4 (hidden in Place/Hold)

spatial_layout.name: StepTabBar
spatial_layout.note: vertical glass capsule, 5 round 2.4 cm tabs at 2.8 cm pitch; x -10.1..-6.9 vs window -4.9..10.1 = 2 cm gap (coplanar, no intersection)

ownership.Assets/Scripts/CPRCoach.ts: EXTEND existing @component CPRCoach on root 'CPRCoach': step state (Step enum unchanged), count/timers/swap, hold sub-state, beat, guide press anim + texture swap, heart pulse, audio cues, manikin visibility, UI placement mode; drives CPRCoachUI via setters, subscribes ui.onAction -> next(); binds guide IK Interactable in OnStartEvent (onTriggerStart -> beginHold, onTriggerEnd/onTriggerCanceled -> cancelHold); header comment justifies size if >250 lines
ownership.Assets/Scripts/CPRCoachUI.ts: @component on 'CPRCoachUI' root (children StepWindow, StepTabBar): passive UIKit view (Frame, texts, one button, progress bar, tab bar); no step logic; never moves its own root
ownership.Assets/Scripts/CPRCoachPlacement.ts: plain TS module, no @component: pure pose math returning {position: vec3, rotation: quat}: manikinPose(camT, chestDistance, floorBelowEye), chestPoint(manikinT), followPose(camT, distance, currentPos, dt), anchoredWindowPose(chestPos, towardHead, camPos), heartPose(chestPos, right, camPos); no scene mutation

cpr_coach_changes: new @inputs (References): ui: CPRCoachUI; uiRoot: SceneObject; heart: SceneObject; manikin: SceneObject; guideInteractable: Interactable (IK); handsWhite: Texture; handsGreen: Texture; buttonAudio: AudioComponent; holdAudio: AudioComponent

OnStartEvent: clone guide material, place manikin via Placement (floor = camY - 90, chest manikinDistance ahead), hide manikin when !global.deviceInfoSystem.isEditor(), bind ui.onAction and guide Interactable, goTo(Check)

goTo(): push ui.setStepLabel/setInstruction/setCounter/setButton/setActiveTab/setHoldProgress(0,false); heart enabled only in Push; Watch: guide on manikin chest (editor) else camera-relative placeGuide fallback, anchor UI + heart; Check: UI back to follow mode, guide + heart hidden

Place/Hold: hold active if pinch-hold on guide OR both palms within handRadius; on start GREEN + handsGreen, instruction 'Hold still', progress elapsed/holdSeconds shown; early release WHITE + handsWhite, progress 0 hidden; complete holdAudio.play(1) then goTo(Push)
Push: beat unchanged (clickAudio per beat, count++); heart scale 1.12 at each beat easing to 1.0 within the beat; swap reminder via setCounter for 3 s every swapEvery
Done: instruction 'Help is here', counter 'Time m:ss · N compressions', button 'Finish'; Finish goes to Check
next(): buttonAudio.play(1) then existing advance logic; no-op in Place
setColor(c): keep baseColor tint and swap mainPass.baseTex to handsGreen/handsWhite
update(): follow-mode tick of uiRoot via Placement.followPose while step is Check or Call

exposure_plan.CPRCoach: References: existing (instructionText/counterText now @allowUndefined, guide, guideVisual, clickAudio, camera) + ui, uiRoot, heart, manikin, guideInteractable, handsWhite, handsGreen, buttonAudio, holdAudio. Settings: bpm Slider 100-120, pressDepth Slider 2-6, handRadius Slider 5-20, swapEvery Slider 5-300 default 120, holdSeconds Slider 0.5-3, followDistance Slider 35-70, manikinDistance Slider 40-90, chestWindowScale Slider 1-2. 8 tunables because the 4 pre-existing ones are user-mandated.
exposure_plan.CPRCoachUI: Settings: accentColor ColorWidget vec4 #F2392C, glassTint ColorWidget vec4 light grey (0.85,0.87,0.9,0.35), textColor ColorWidget white. References: 5 icon Textures from Assets/Icons/ (warning, call, back_hand, monitor_heart, check_circle)

wiring.CPRCoach.clickAudio: AudioComponent on CPRCoach root, Assets/GeneratedSFX/BeatClick.wav, LowLatency
wiring.Scene hygiene: InteractionKitExamples removed/disabled; CPRCoach root above CPRCoachUI in hierarchy

public_methods: setButton(label: string, visible: boolean, accent: boolean): void
ui_api.notes: setActiveTab index 0..4: tabs < index finished (white icon), == index active (filled white circle, dark icon), > index upcoming (45% opacity). Button pinch fires onAction. Build UIKit content in onAwake; buffer setter calls made before build. CPRCoach moves the root transform; the module must not reposition its own root.
